columns.name: SKU

columns.name: Currency

columns.name: Sales unit

columns.name: Price list

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Numeric, never null, 12 distinct values (1234.56–1356.77) tracking one row per SKU; mapped as the supplied net amount with no tax adjustment, per the alternate contract.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Boolean flag, 'No' for all 12 rows, meaning the net price is stated excluding tax. It has no dedicated target property but justifies keeping net_amount unadjusted while reporting tax_fraction separately.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Constant '5%' in all rows; parsed as a Thai-style percentage into the fraction 0.05 required by /money/tax_fraction. Fixture value, applied as written, no VAT assumption added.

columns.name: Valid from (DD/MM/YYYY)
columns.reason: Header states DD/MM/YYYY and the only value is 03/04/2026 (year 2026, so CE, not Buddhist era); parsed day-first into the ISO date string for /valid_from.
